101 Blockchains: Paid blockchain and Web3 certification courses aimed at people who need a credential for work, not crypto hype. Worth it if an employer or client actually asks for proof of training; skip it if you're just curious, because free material covers the basics.
Abracadabra NYC: A Manhattan costume and magic shop that's been open since 1981, selling masks, full costumes, theatrical makeup and stage magic. The place to look when a party-store costume won't cut it and you want something that photographs well.
Academy for Health & Fitness: Online CPD-accredited courses in fitness, nutrition, health and business skills. Good value for building a resume line or exploring a field before paying for a full certification; check that the accreditation is recognized where you work.
Adept Knives: Folding and fixed-blade knives built around premium steels for everyday carry and outdoor use. For people who already know they want a real blade, not a gas-station folder; check your state and city carry laws before ordering.
Air France KLM Flying Blue - Points.com: The official way to buy Flying Blue miles when you're a few short of an award flight. Only worth it during a bonus sale and only when you've priced the exact award ticket first; buying miles 'for later' rarely beats cash.
Airalo: Prepaid eSIM data plans for 200+ countries, installed from an app before you fly. The easiest way to land with working data and skip roaming fees; your phone has to be carrier-unlocked and eSIM-capable.
Airbrush US: Photo retouching software for portraits: skin cleanup, blemish removal and batch edits on desktop. A faster, simpler option than full Photoshop for creators editing a lot of people photos; go easy on the smoothing slider.
Airhub App: Another prepaid travel eSIM covering 190+ countries. Compare its regional bundles against Airalo for multi-country trips; whichever is cheaper per gigabyte for your route wins.
Airport Transfer Portal: Pre-booked private transfers from airports in 100+ countries, matched to vetted local drivers. Worth it when you land late, travel with kids or luggage, or don't speak the language; confirm the meeting point before you fly.
Airvape USA: US-designed portable dry herb vaporizers known for slim, pocketable bodies and simple controls. One of the brands Pixie's Pantry started on, and a strong pick for anyone who found bigger portables too bulky to actually carry.
Alaska Airlines ATMOS Rewards - Points.c: Official purchase portal for Alaska Airlines Atmos Rewards miles. Alaska miles go far on partner airlines, so a bonus sale can top off a specific award; never buy speculatively.
Alfred Systems - US: An app that turns an old phone into a security camera, plus inexpensive AlfredCam hardware. The cheapest real way to watch a door, a pet or a grow tent; paid tiers add better video history.
Alison US CA: Thousands of free online courses with optional paid certificates, from workplace safety to IT. Take the course free, and only pay for a certificate if you need to show it to someone.
ALLPOWERS (US & CA): Portable power stations and folding solar panels for outages, camping and RV use. A budget-friendly alternative to the big names; match the battery capacity to what you actually need to run, and check surge watts for anything with a motor.
Alorair the dry air: Heavy-duty ETL and Energy Star dehumidifiers for basements, crawl spaces and flood cleanup, with a 5-year warranty and US support. Built for Southern humidity and wet crawl spaces; size it to your square footage, not the cheapest box.
AlorairCrawlspace: AlorAir's crawl-space line: low-profile dehumidifiers built to sit under a house and run constantly. If you've got mildew smell or sagging floors in a humid climate, this is the category that actually fixes it.
Amanda Hair: Human hair wigs, bundles and closures. Read the hair grade, density and cap construction on each listing before buying, and check the return policy for opened units.
Amazonliss (US): Salon-style keratin treatments and repair products sold direct as the Bondox line. For frizz and damage from heat styling; follow the ventilation and heat instructions exactly, since keratin treatments are not forgiving.
American College of Benefit Specialists: Professional certifications in medical, pharmacy, retirement and voluntary employee benefits. Niche and practical; useful if you work in HR, insurance or brokerage and need recognized credentials.
Amigo eSIM: Prepaid travel eSIM plans for international trips. Compare it on price per gigabyte for your destination and validity length; my partner code works here too.
AMZCHEF ELECTRIC CO., LIMITED: Small kitchen appliances and countertop beverage coolers sold under the Bodega Cooler storefront. Good for a bar cart, game room or office; measure your space and check noise ratings before ordering.
AnkerSOLIX: Anker's home energy line: portable power stations, SolarBank balcony systems and solar generators. Anker's support and warranty are the reason to pay a little more than no-name brands; size to your outage needs.
Anthbot US: Robot lawn mowers that run on GPS-style mapping instead of a buried boundary wire. Best for regular-shaped, fairly flat yards; check slope limits and yard size before buying for a big Mississippi lot.
AOHI: High-wattage GaN chargers and power banks built for laptops, phones and tablets at once. Good for travel and work bags; confirm the wattage your laptop actually needs.
AOSU: Wireless security cameras, solar cameras and video doorbells, many with no monthly fee. A budget way to cover a property; check whether the features you want need the subscription.
Clip-on and case-mount lenses that give a phone telephoto, macro and wide shots. Handy for product photos and close-up shots of flower and glass without buying a real camera.
Apolosign: Portable smart TVs, digital family calendars and photo frames. The calendar displays are the standout for busy households; check app compatibility with the calendars you already use.
ApplicantAlly: An AI assistant that helps job candidates prepare for and structure answers in interviews. Best used for practice runs; know the employer's rules before using any tool during a live interview.
Arbiship - eBay Dropshipping Automation: Automation software for eBay arbitrage sellers that places supplier orders and uploads tracking. Only relevant if you already run a dropshipping store; read eBay's current dropshipping policy first.
Arccaptain: MIG, TIG and stick welders, plasma cutters and auto-darkening helmets for hobbyists and working fabricators. Strong value for a home shop or farm repair work; buy the right voltage for your outlet.
Argendon Crawlspace & commercial dehumid: Energy-efficient dehumidifiers for crawl spaces, basements and commercial spaces. Another solid option for fighting mold and musty air in a humid climate; compare pints-per-day and drain options against AlorAir.
AromaPassions: Perfumes and colognes built around premium scent profiles at fair prices. Order a smaller size first if you're buying a scent blind.
ArtChineseDesign: Hand-stitched Su embroidery and traditional lacquerware made by artisans. A genuinely unusual gift for someone who appreciates handwork; expect artisan lead times rather than next-day shipping.
ARZOPA: Thin portable monitors that plug into a laptop or console over USB-C or HDMI. The easiest dual-screen setup for travel, a booth or a kitchen-table office; check your laptop's USB-C supports video out.
Ashimary Hair: 100% human hair wigs in lace front and glueless styles. Read the density, length and lace type on each listing, and look at customer photos rather than studio shots.
ASMAX: Motorcycle riding gear and smart portable tire inflators at budget prices. The inflators are handy for any vehicle; for riding gear, check the impact-protection rating before you trust it.
Astra Trainer: A gamified app with short lessons on business, psychology, relationships and dog training. Good for learning in five-minute chunks; try the free content before paying for a plan.
AtomStack: Desktop laser engravers and cutters for wood, leather, acrylic and more. A real small-business tool for custom trays, signs and branded merch; budget for ventilation and eye protection.
Aurzen: Smart portable projectors for movie nights indoors or outside. Fine for casual viewing in a dark room; check brightness specs if you want to use it before full dark.
AUTELOnline: An authorized dealer for Autel automotive diagnostic scanners, from DIY code readers to pro-level tools. Saves a shop visit just to read a check-engine light; buying through an authorized dealer protects the warranty.
AV Access: KVM switches, docking stations and HDMI and USB extenders for multi-computer desks and AV setups. Problem-solving gear for anyone running two computers on one keyboard and monitor.
Avid Hemp: Full-spectrum CBD products, best known for nighttime gummies, with third-party lab testing. Check the COA for the exact batch you're buying and start low if you're new.
AW Bridal: Wedding dresses, bridesmaid dresses and formalwear made to order online. Order fabric swatches and leave plenty of time for custom sizing and shipping before the date.
Awin (USD): An administrative Awin programme with no products for sale. Listed only for completeness; there is nothing to buy here.
AWIN AFFILIATE - M. Atlas Technologies: HoverEcho adds audio previews to digital ads. A business-to-business tool for advertisers, not something a shopper buys.
Baby Gold: Personalized 14K solid gold jewelry made in Los Angeles, including engraved and initial pieces. Solid gold costs more up front but won't tarnish or turn your skin green; custom pieces are usually final sale.
Bagail: Packing cubes and travel organizers with good zippers and sturdy fabric. An easy upgrade for anyone living out of a carry-on; compression cubes save real space.
Base44: An AI platform that builds working web apps from plain-English descriptions. Great for quick internal tools and prototypes; anything handling payments or customer data still needs a real review.
Bcengi: A reusable global eSIM with pay-as-you-go data that doesn't expire, covering 200+ countries. Best for frequent travellers who hate buying a new plan every trip.
Bedsure: Affordable comforters, sheets, blankets and pet beds. Strong value for guest rooms and kids' beds; check fabric type if you sleep hot.
Benigna Parfums LLC: Independent fragrance house making its own perfumes. Try a sample first; niche scents can wear very differently on skin than the description suggests.
Best Choice Products: Budget-friendly furniture, patio sets, toys and home goods. Good for value buys; read the assembly and weight-limit details before ordering larger pieces.
Betckey: Compatible printer labels, label makers and thermal paper at lower prices than name brands. Useful for shipping labels and product tags; confirm the label size matches your printer model.
Bgmgirl hair company: Unprocessed virgin human hair wigs, bundles, closures and frontals in many colors. Compare lace type and density across listings, and expect premium pricing for longer lengths.
bids.com inc: An online auction marketplace for jewelry, watches, bags and collectibles at steep discounts. Set a maximum bid and stick to it, and add buyer's premium and shipping before you call it a deal.
Big Horn Outdoors: Backyard cooking gear: pizza ovens, grills and outdoor kitchen tools. A good entry point into outdoor pizza ovens without premium-brand pricing.
Bighorn Outdoor: Camping gear for car campers and overlanders: shelters, sleeping gear and campsite cooking hardware. Built for comfort at the truck, not ultralight backpacking.
Billion Dollar Beauty (US): Simple beauty tools and fixes, like heatless curlers and makeup removers, built around one problem each. Inexpensive and easy to try.
Binoid CBD: A hemp-derived cannabinoid brand selling vapes, gummies and tinctures. Check the lab report for the exact product, and know your state's hemp rules before ordering; 21+.
Black Widow Pro Amazon: Loading ramps, carriers, wheel chocks and hauling gear made for ATV, UTV and motorcycle owners. Check the weight rating against your machine, not just the price.
eGift cards and prepaid cards for 125+ brands, sold for use in Canada. Only useful for Canadian recipients; US shoppers should look elsewhere.
Blimburn Seeds: A seed bank since 2002 with 1,000+ varieties from established breeders. Check your state's laws on seeds and home cultivation before ordering.
Bloomz Hemp: Hemp and CBD products. Read the lab report for each batch and confirm hemp products are legal to ship to your state; 21+.
Bluehost: WordPress-focused web hosting with a free domain the first year. A fine starting point for a small business site; watch the renewal price, which jumps after the intro term.
BODYJEWELRY.COM: A large catalog of body piercing jewelry: rings, studs, plugs and replacement balls. Look for implant-grade titanium or surgical steel if you have sensitive skin or a fresh piercing.
BookSeats: Packages that bundle sports and concert tickets with hotels and flights. Handy for a big away game or bucket-list show; compare the bundle against booking each piece separately.
Border Free Health US: A prescription referral service connecting patients with accredited international pharmacies for lower-cost medications. Requires a valid prescription; talk to your doctor and check your insurance before switching.
Botslab US: Dash cams, security cameras and video doorbells. Competitive pricing; check the storage options (cloud vs SD card) before you buy.
brickzonehub: Custom frames, acrylic cases and stands for LEGO sets. For collectors who want sets dust-free and on display; ships from the UK, so plan for shipping time.
brkox: LED light kits and display cases made to fit specific LEGO sets. A fun way to finish a big build; match the kit to your exact set number.
Brondell: Bidet seats, water filtration and air purifiers designed for regular homes. The bidet seats are an easy, renter-friendly bathroom upgrade; check your toilet shape and outlet location.
Brondell Seller Program: Brondell's bidets and home goods sold through Amazon. Same products as Brondell direct; compare prices and return terms on both before you order.
Brookwood Med: Medical, safety and personal protective supplies for homes and businesses. Useful for stocking a first-aid kit or a shop's safety shelf.
BurchdaBikes: Off-road electric mountain bikes with powerful motors and long range. Check your local trail rules on e-bikes and plan how you'll get parts and service.
BusinessAnywhere LLC: Online LLC formation, registered agent, virtual mailbox, notary and EIN filing in one dashboard. Handy for new sole owners; compare against filing directly with your state, which can be cheaper.
Buture: Budget cordless stick vacuums and cleaning tools. Good value for small homes and cars; check runtime on the highest power setting, not just the max number.
Canadian Insulin: Ships diabetes and weight-management medications from licensed Canadian pharmacies at lower prices. A valid prescription is required; confirm it's legal for your situation and talk to your doctor.
Cannabox: One of the longest-running smoke-shop subscription boxes, plus a full online headshop. Good for building an accessory drawer cheaply; compare its box against Pixie's Pantry's own boxes before subscribing.
CapCut Affiliate Program: CapCut Pro: video editing, templates and AI tools for short-form content. Most creators can start on the free version and only upgrade for specific Pro features.
Distinctive engagement rings and wedding bands with unusual gemstones like moss agate and salt-and-pepper diamonds. For couples who don't want a cookie-cutter ring; check resizing and care rules for softer stones.
CaraKit (US): Care packages for people going through cancer treatment, curated by a breast cancer survivor. A thoughtful gift when you don't know what to send; kits are built around chemo, radiation and surgery recovery.
CBDSOL: A French online CBD shop selling flower, resin, oils and vapes. Ships within Europe; not an option for US buyers.
CenterPoint Archery (US): Crossbows and archery gear for hunters. Budget-friendly entry into crossbow hunting; check your state's season and crossbow regulations.
Central Vapors: A US vape shop since 2013 that makes its own e-liquid and ships direct. Old guard and still around; check your state's shipping rules for vape products. 21+.
Cerqular: Refurbished and pre-owned electronics as an eco-friendly alternative to buying new. Check the condition grade and warranty length on every listing.
Changed (US): An app that rounds up purchases and automates extra debt payments while tracking every balance in one place. Helpful if you need a push to pay debt down faster; compare the fee against what you'll save in interest.
Chefman: Affordable air fryers, toasters, kettles and countertop appliances. Strong value for everyday cooking; check the warranty on the specific model.
CHEUNG FU INC: Vanimy fashion jewelry: rings, necklaces and earrings at low prices. Good for trend pieces; check the base metal if you react to nickel.
Chicsew Trading Co., Limited: Sewing, embroidery and craft supplies. Useful for hobby sewing and custom merch projects; check thread and fabric specs against your machine.
